raw_graphql_pull_request.body: # [Bugfix][Core] Forward `extra_args` to beam search's per-step `SamplingParams` ## Summary Custom logits processors never receive their arguments under beam search. `BeamSearchParams` has no `extra_args` field, and the per-step and per-beam `SamplingParams` built in `beam_search/{offline,online}.py` do not carry one -- so a processor that reads `SamplingParams.extra_args` silently sees an empty mapping, declines the request, and generation proceeds as if unconfigured. There is no error and no warning. It works as documented under ordinary sampling. Adds `extra_args` to `BeamSearchParams` and forwards it at the three construction sites. ## Motivation The V2 logits-processor plugin mechanism documents `extra_args` as how a processor receives per-request arguments (REST `vllm_xargs`, OpenAI SDK `extra_body`). Under beam search a caller sees plausible output that silently ignored their parameters. Verified on a live engine (A10G, `facebook/opt-125m`): with the patch the processor's read point receives `target_token=128` on every request; without it, `None`. The use case this blocks is prefix-dependent constrained decoding over a large closed set -- generative retrieval, where the constraint is a catalog-sized structure the processor owns. The declarative alternative is not a substitute: the beam path calls `backend.compile_grammar()` once **per beam per step**, because backends cannot clone grammar state and tokens are replayed instead. Measured with xgrammar 0.1.29 on a `choice` grammar, multiplied by W*C for width 10, depth 5: | catalog | one compile | per request | |---|---|---| | 1,000 | 0.96 s | 48 s | | 10,000 | 2.08 s | 104 s | | 100,000 | 23.2 s | 1,161 s | So for catalog-sized constraints a plugin is the only viable mechanism, and `extra_args` is how it is configured. ## Approach `extra_args` is already `dict[str, Any] | None` on `SamplingParams`, documented as "arbitrary additional args, that can be used by custom sampling implementations, plugins, etc." This mirrors it onto `BeamSearchParams` and passes it through unchanged. No behaviour change for callers who do not set it. ### Three sites, not one `offline.py` builds `SamplingParams` **twice** -- a base per step, and a per-beam one in `_build_beam_sampling_params()` when structured outputs are active. Forwarding only the base would leave the grammar path silently dropping the arguments, the same class of bug as the original. `online.py` has the server-side equivalent. Each internal request gets its own mapping. The per-step params are built with `skip_clone=True`, so `SamplingParams.clone` shallow-copies and every beam would otherwise share one dict, unlike the ordinary generate path which deep-copies; a processor that mutated its arguments could then change what later beams observe. Values are shared, only the mapping is fresh. ## Changes - `vllm/sampling_params.py` -- `BeamSearchParams.extra_args: dict[str, Any] | None = None`. - `vllm/entrypoints/generate/beam_search/offline.py` -- forward in `base_sampling_params` and in `_build_beam_sampling_params`. - `vllm/entrypoints/generate/beam_search/online.py` -- forward in the server-side per-step params. - `vllm/entrypoints/generate/beam_search/utils.py` -- `copy_extra_args()`. - `tests/entrypoints/unit_tests/test_beam_search_extra_args.py` (new) -- 4 tests. - `tests/v1/logits_processors/test_custom_offline.py` -- 1 test. ## Test Plan ``` pytest -v tests/entrypoints/unit_tests/test_beam_search_extra_args.py pytest -v tests/v1/logits_processors/test_custom_offline.py::test_custom_logitsprocs_beam_search ``` The unit tests assert `BeamSearchParams` has the **field** (parsed from the AST, not grepped -- the first version searched for the string `extra_args`, which the field's own docstring satisfies, so deleting the field left the test green), and that **every** `SamplingParams(...)` construction in the beam-search modules passes `extra_args`. The live test asserts the processor *receives* its argument, through a recording subclass of the existing `DummyLogitsProcessor`. It deliberately does **not** assert that the processor changes the output: beam search selects from the *returned* logprobs, which are computed before logits processors run under the default `logprobs_mode`, so a processor cannot steer beam selection without further configuration. Asserting output forcing would make this test fail for a reason this patch is not responsible for. ## Test Result A10G, vLLM at `c50aca1441`: ``` tests/entrypoints/unit_tests/test_beam_search_extra_args.py .... [100%] 4 passed in 0.06s tests/v1/logits_processors/test_custom_offline.py::test_custom_logitsprocs_beam_search PASSED 1 passed in 615.96s ``` Negative-controlled: with the forwarding reverted and the test unchanged, it fails with `processor received [None], expected every request to carry 128; extra_args did not reach the per-step SamplingParams`. Each of the unit-test edits was also reverted individually and the corresponding test watched to fail. **Wins:** a documented plugin mechanism becomes reachable under beam search; no behaviour change for callers who do not set `extra_args`. **Cost (honest tradeoff):** this is plumbing only. It makes the arguments arrive; it does not by itself let a plugin shape beam-search output, because the returned logprobs beam search selects from are computed before logits processors run. That needs `logprobs_mode="processed_logprobs"` and a non-null `allowed_token_ids` as well -- verified working, but out of scope here. **Not verified:** the structured-outputs path. I had a parametrization covering the per-beam construction site, but it cannot run: `backend_name == "auto"` is unhandled in `beam_search/offline.py`, so any beam request with `structured_outputs` set raises `ValueError: Unsupported structured output backend: auto` on the default config. That looks like a separate upstream bug and I will file it separately; this PR therefore has no coverage of the second construction site, which I would rather state than paper over. vLLM's own beam-search suite has not been run either (needs an engine; single-GPU box). ## AI Assistance Disclosure Written with AI assistance (Claude). I directed the investigation, chose the fix shape, and reviewed every line. The measurements above (grammar compile times, the live before/after, the negative control) were produced on the hardware named. Commits carry a `Co-authored-by:` trailer per vLLM's guidance. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Beam search must forward `extra_args` to its per-step `SamplingParams`.
+
+A custom logits processor reads its per-request arguments from
+`SamplingParams.extra_args`. That works under ordinary sampling. Under beam search it
+did not: `BeamSearchParams` had no `extra_args` field, and the per-step and per-beam
+`SamplingParams` built in `beam_search/{offline,online}.py` did not carry one -- so a
+processor was silently unreachable whenever beam search was in play. Nothing failed; the
+processor simply never saw its arguments.
+
+The end-to-end regression test is
+`tests/v1/logits_processors/test_custom_offline.py::test_custom_logitsprocs_beam_search`,
+which asserts through `LLM.beam_search` that a processor actually receives the
+arguments. The checks here are the cheap complement: the field exists, and no
+`SamplingParams` construction on the beam path forgets the keyword. The defect was an
+omitted keyword argument, and a new construction site that forgets it is exactly what
+the source guard catches and an end-to-end test on the other sites would not.
+"""
+
+import ast
+import pathlib
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.sampling_params import BeamSearchParams
+
+pytestmark = [pytest.mark.cpu_test, pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup]
+
+REPO_ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+BEAM_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "vllm" / "entrypoints" / "generate" / "beam_search"
+
+
+def test_beam_search_params_accepts_and_stores_extra_args():
+    """Without the field, a caller cannot pass processor arguments at all."""
+    params = BeamSearchParams(
+        beam_width=2, max_tokens=4, extra_args={"target_token": 128}
+    )
+    assert params.extra_args == {"target_token": 128}
+
+
+def test_beam_search_params_extra_args_defaults_to_none():
+    """The field is additive: callers who do not set it are unaffected."""
+    assert BeamSearchParams(beam_width=2, max_tokens=4).extra_args is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("module_name", ["offline.py", "online.py"])
+def test_every_sampling_params_in_the_beam_path_forwards_extra_args(module_name):
+    """Each construction, not just one.
+
+    The offline path builds two -- a base per step and a per-beam one from the grammar
+    -- and forwarding only the base leaves structured-outputs beam search silently
+    dropping the arguments.
+    """
+    tree = ast.parse((BEAM_DIR / module_name).read_text())
+    calls = [
+        node
+        for node in ast.walk(tree)
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Call)
+        and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
+        and node.func.id == "SamplingParams"
+    ]
+    assert calls, f"no SamplingParams construction found in {module_name}"
+
+    missing = [
+        node.lineno
+        for node in calls
+        if "extra_args" not in {kw.arg for kw in node.keywords if kw.arg}
+    ]
+    assert not missing, (
+        f"{module_name}: SamplingParams built without extra_args at line(s) "
+        f"{missing}; a custom logits processor cannot see its per-request "
+        "arguments on this path"
+    )

+@create_new_process_for_each_test()
+def test_custom_logitsprocs_beam_search(monkeypatch):
+    """A custom logits processor must receive `extra_args` under beam search.
+
+    `BeamSearchParams` had no `extra_args` field and the per-step `SamplingParams`
+    did not carry one, so a processor registered through the `vllm.logits_processors`
+    entry point never saw its arguments when beam search was in play -- with no
+    error. `add_request()` was handed an empty mapping, the processor declined the
+    request, and generation proceeded as if unconfigured.
+
+    What this asserts is that the arguments arrive, which is what the fix provides.
+    It deliberately does not assert that the processor changes the output: beam
+    search selects from the *returned* logprobs, which are computed before logits
+    processors run under the default `logprobs_mode`, so a processor cannot steer
+    beam selection without further configuration. Conflating the two would make
+    this test fail for a reason the fix is not responsible for.
+    """
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING", "1")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", "0")
+    set_random_seed(40)
+
+    target_token = 128
+    seen: list[int | None] = []
+
+    class RecordingLogitsProcessor(DummyLogitsProcessor):
+        """Records the per-request argument the processor is handed."""
+
+        @staticmethod
+        def _get_target_token(params: SamplingParams) -> int | None:
+            value = DummyLogitsProcessor._get_target_token(params)
+            seen.append(value)
+            return value
+
+    llm = LLM(
+        model=MODEL_NAME,
+        gpu_memory_utilization=0.1,
+        logits_processors=[RecordingLogitsProcessor],
+    )
+    tokenizer = llm.get_tokenizer()
+    token_prompts = [
+        TokensPrompt(prompt_token_ids=tokenizer.encode(prompt)) for prompt in prompts
+    ]
+
+    outputs = llm.beam_search(
+        token_prompts,
+        BeamSearchParams(
+            beam_width=2,
+            max_tokens=MAX_TOKENS,
+            temperature=TEMP_GREEDY,
+            extra_args={DUMMY_LOGITPROC_ARG: target_token},
+        ),
+    )
+
+    assert len(outputs) == len(token_prompts)
+    assert seen, "the logits processor was never consulted"
+    assert all(value == target_token for value in seen), (
+        f"processor received {sorted(set(seen))}, expected every request to carry "
+        f"{target_token}; extra_args did not reach the per-step SamplingParams"
+    )
+
+

     """Test passing request-level logits processor to offline Python interface.

         )
         params.configure_logprobs(
             sampling_params, self.engine_client.input_processor.vllm_config

@@ -17,6 +17,16 @@
 from vllm.sampling_params import SamplingParams
 
 
+def copy_extra_args(extra_args: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    """Give each internal beam-search request its own `extra_args` mapping.
+
+    The per-step params are built with ``skip_clone=True``, so `SamplingParams.clone`
+    shallow-copies and every beam would otherwise share one dict, unlike the ordinary
+    generate path which deep-copies. Values are shared; only the mapping is fresh.
+    """
+    return dict(extra_args) if extra_args else None
+
+
 @dataclass
 class BeamSearchSequence:
     """A sequence for beam search.

@@ -1514,6 +1514,10 @@ class BeamSearchParams(
     skip_special_tokens: bool = True
     watermarking: bool | None = None
     allowed_token_ids: list[int] | None = None
+    extra_args: dict[str, Any] | None = None
+    """Arbitrary additional args, forwarded to the per-step SamplingParams so that
+    custom logits processors and other plugins are reachable under beam search as
+    they are under ordinary sampling."""
 
     def __post_init__(self) -> None:
         _verify_num_sequences(self.beam_width, "beam_width")
